config.enabled.name: Enable Mod
config.solid-placement.name: Allow Solid Placement Under Player
config.solid-placement.tooltip: Allow placing solid objects (chests, machines, sprinklers, fences, trellis seeds, furniture) on your standing tile and push you to an adjacent empty tile. Blocked if no safe exit tile exists.
config.push-direction.name: Preferred Push Direction
config.push-direction.tooltip: Order for choosing an adjacent empty tile when pushed off a newly placed solid item.
config.diagonal-push.name: Allow Diagonal Push
config.diagonal-push.tooltip: If all 4 cardinal adjacent tiles are blocked, allow pushing onto an open diagonal adjacent tile.
config.push-style.name: Push Movement Style
config.push-style.tooltip: How the player is displaced onto the adjacent empty tile.
config.face-placed.name: Face Placed Item After Push
config.face-placed.tooltip: Turn the player to face the newly placed item after being pushed onto an adjacent tile.
